newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 5.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Thursday rose in line with crude gains eventhough the cargo market remained lacklustre, traders said. Sellers said shipowners were at a stand off as current prices were too high. The spread between 180-cst and 380-cst has widened as prices of gas oil - used as a cutter stock for reducing the viscosity of 280-cst/380-cst fuel oil down to 180-cst - is at a new-five peak. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3082)
